queries.purpose: Retrieve source dataset metadata, chronology controls, references before accepting sampled pollen dates; no new fossil search or non-representative source selection.

evidence_requirements: At least one source chronology attached to a dataset does not by itself validate every Alnus sample's age model
Original chronology/sample age-depth model, calibration and dated depths must support sample age within 18-24ka uncertainty before fossil location admitted
Species pollen diagnostics must be reviewed against source publications and alternative Alnus species, and pollen transport must be accounted for
6 datasets from 6 sites are source site units, not 26 independent species-level historical population observations
Missing metadata/HTTP failure does not imply absence of valid LGM fossil or misidentification
Original v13 candidate source is not a confirmed fossil survey of 416 plant taxa
No insect genetics, no 21ka host corridors, no retune of TTF/chocho negative real-other-plant controls
